programme.desc: Jurors heard about the children and teens affected in the deadly parade crash. The State brought in a high school band director who was leading her students right before the SUV came into the crowd. She testified that she knew there was something wrong when the music stopped as she was marching with her students during the deadly parade crash. She said that when she turned, she saw a red SUV ram into them and others. In the end, six people died.

programme.title: On The Trail Of...
programme.desc: Criminally Insane takes viewers on an unprecedented journey through the Clifton T. Perkins hospital in Jessup, Maryland, a maximum-security institution for the criminally insane. All the patients at Perkins have been found not guilty by reason of insanity, and virtually all have committed extremely violent crimes. Elsoudani El-Wahhabi stabbed a woman to death, then cut out his own tongue. Brian Bechtold murdered both his parents with a shotgun when he was just 17 years old. Todd E. beat his mother with a baseball bat, then finished her off with a kitchen knife. In one hour, CRIMINALLY INSANE portrays the most intimate details of life among the dangerously mentally ill. We learn what’s being done for them and, more importantly, who decides whether these terrifying individuals are ready to be released.

All the patients at Perkins have been found not guilty by reason of insanity, and virtually all have committed extremely violent crimes. Elsoudani El-Wahhabi stabbed a woman to death, then cut out his own tongue. Brian Bechtold murdered both his parents with a shotgun when he was just 17 years old. Todd E. beat his mother with a baseball bat, then finished her off with a kitchen knife. In one hour, CRIMINALLY INSANE portrays the most intimate details of life among the dangerously mentally ill. We learn what’s being done for them and, more importantly, who decides whether these terrifying individuals are ready to be released.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights’ Academy save the kingdom? It’s final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights’ Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn’t want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King’s Jester. He’s terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn’t want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King’s Jester. He’s terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!
